purpose: Micro-correction, round 2: E2.2.1 exposed structural_composition vocabulary and only reached 3/20 (0.15). Root-cause analysis of E2.2.1's own trial reports found the real gap was two unstated structural contracts: (1) a feature name must have ONE type across every concept sharing it (not decided per-concept-locally from that concept's own evidence), (2) repaired_concepts must return the complete concept set, not a partial diff. This design states both contracts explicitly in the prompt AND enforces contract (2) structurally via schema minItems. Still a single-arm control-affordance check, NOT a B-C hypothesis test.
source: dir1_directed fixture and oracle copied verbatim from experiments/2026-07-23_isa_certificate_structure_bvsc/fixture.json (frozen E2.2 design, commit 49f030b), via experiments/2026-07-24_e2.2.1_directed_pc_vocabulary_fix/fixture.json. Not modified.
